title: Do anatomical action coordinates improve single-step exploration?
hypothesis: A fixed anatomical synergy action interface reduces uncoordinated joint commands and lets single-step symbolic search discover sustained spinning more readily than unrestricted joint-by-joint actions.

prediction.rationale: Require at least +0.15 fresh sustained success and a paired t interval above zero across four search blocks; validity or smoother actions alone would not establish useful exploration.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study anatomical_action_coordinates"'
code_changes: scripts/run_full_evolution.py: add the paired action-interface study using the Isaac backend; disable fitting and trace repair in both arms to isolate exploration.

config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml: freeze a neutral pose and eight anatomical action coordinates—one flexion coordinate for each digit, thumb opposition, shared long-finger spread, and shared distal curl—mapped to the existing normalized 20-joint target interface.

Freeze the mapping from joint names and limits before simulator tuning; do not derive it from PPO demonstrations or embed the previously tuned scripted gait. Give both arms identical anatomical information and action conventions.

Use four matched blocks, one generated structure per interface per block, identical symbolic-parameter limits, 24 rollout-search settings, and four probe cases. Permit one validity correction per generated structure using gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning_effort high, temperature 1.
Use ten-case screens, unchanged strict promotion on development cases 10-39, and 30 fresh cases per block; evaluate the existing baseline rather than assuming its success is zero.

Reuse the Isaac adapter and its separate-process parity guard at batch sizes 4, 10, and 30. Budget 88 guard episodes, 768 search episodes, 80 screening episodes, 360 promotion episodes, and 240 fresh episodes.

Record action saturation and variation as diagnostics only; judge the prediction on paired fresh incumbent success across blocks. This changes the executable action space, unlike prior MetaWorld bank seeding or parameter-depth comparisons.

falsified_by: The paired interval's upper bound is below +0.15; tied success does not support the hypothesis, and an interval spanning zero is inconclusive.
direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This is a useful action-representation experiment, but its 1536 episodes and at most 16 LLM calls should follow R-042's validated Isaac integration and direct-action exploration results. Its weakest point is that eight fixed coordinates can exclude essential spinning motions as well as reduce coordination difficulty; the comparison therefore establishes interface utility, not dimensionality reduction alone. Retain paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.15 against direct 20-joint exploration, with the declared upper-bound-below-0.15 falsifier; ties are not improvements and zero-crossing intervals are inconclusive.

implementer.reasoning: Agree: needs the Isaac pipeline backend R-042 builds and a direct-action exploration result to compare against; and eight fixed coordinates may exclude the flexion-slope roll mechanism found in R-039, so it measures interface utility, not dimensionality.
